# montecarlo_snowflake_credentials (Data Source)

Snowflake credentials are a key pair Monte Carlo stores for Snowflake connections to use. The private key is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) Snowflake account identifier, without the host suffix.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `user` (String) Snowflake user the key pair belongs to.
- `warehouse` (String) Snowflake virtual warehouse queries run in. Null when none is set.
